description: Helper class for converting between domain objects and entity/model objects in a banking application. It contains multiple conversion methods for customer, account, address, contact, bank info, transaction, and transfer details.

classes.name: BankingServiceHelper
classes.description: A Spring component providing utility methods to convert between different representations of banking domain objects and data transfer objects.

methods.name: convertToCustomerDomain
methods.description: Converts a Customer entity to CustomerDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToCustomerEntity
methods.description: Converts CustomerDetails domain object to Customer entity.

methods.name: convertToAccountDomain
methods.description: Converts an Account entity to AccountInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToAccountEntity
methods.description: Converts AccountInformation domain object to Account entity.

methods.name: convertToAddressDomain
methods.description: Converts Address model to AddressDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToAddressEntity
methods.description: Converts AddressDetails domain object to Address model.

methods.name: convertToContactDomain
methods.description: Converts Contact model to ContactDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToContactEntity
methods.description: Converts ContactDetails domain object to Contact model.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoDomain
methods.description: Converts BankInfo model to BankInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoEntity
methods.description: Converts BankInformation domain object to BankInfo model.

methods.name: convertToTransactionDomain
methods.description: Converts Transaction model to TransactionDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToTransactionEntity
methods.description: Converts TransactionDetails domain object to Transaction model.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Creates a Transaction object based on TransferDetails, account number, and transaction type.
